review: 702.24a-1: the decision fixed payment by tapping both Islands, which the one_island_tapped variant makes impossible; reworded it as a choice to pay that the variant can fail to complete.

scenarios.title: Cumulative upkeep adds an age counter and must be paid in full for every counter

setup.notes: Illusionary Wall (cumulative upkeep {U}) has one age counter. Its cumulative upkeep trigger has just triggered at the beginning of A's upkeep.

decisions: The cumulative upkeep trigger of Illusionary Wall is on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.
A puts an age counter on Illusionary Wall (2 counters), then chooses to pay {U}{U} for the 2 counters, tapping both Islands if both are untapped.

variants.label: full_payment
variants.expected: Illusionary Wall has 2 age counters and stays on the battlefield. Both Islands are tapped.

variants.label: one_island_tapped
variants.delta: One of A's Islands is tapped, so only {U} is available.
variants.expected: A cannot pay the whole {U}{U}; a partial payment is not allowed. Illusionary Wall moves to A's graveyard (sacrificed) and no mana is spent.

variants.label: declines_to_pay
variants.delta: A chooses not to pay although both Islands are untapped.
variants.expected: Illusionary Wall moves to A's graveyard (sacrificed). Both Islands stay untapped.

variants.label: no_prior_counters
variants.delta: Illusionary Wall has no age counters before the trigger.
variants.expected: Illusionary Wall gets its first age counter (1 counter) and A pays only {U} (one Island tapped); Illusionary Wall stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Each instance of cumulative upkeep triggers separately and counts all age counters at resolution

setup.notes: Illusionary Wall has no age counters. It has two instances of cumulative upkeep: its own ({U}) and one granted by Mana Chains ({1}). Both trigger at the beginning of A's upkeep.

decisions: Both cumulative upkeep triggers are on the stack; A orders them so Illusionary Wall's own {U} trigger resolves first. Both players pass.
The first trigger resolves: A puts an age counter on Illusionary Wall (1 counter) and pays {U} by tapping one Island.
The Mana Chains trigger resolves: A puts an age counter on Illusionary Wall (2 counters) and pays {1}{1} for the 2 counters by tapping the other two Islands.

variants.label: both_paid
variants.expected: Illusionary Wall has 2 age counters (one per resolved trigger) and stays on the battlefield. All three Islands are tapped.

variants.label: one_island_tapped
variants.delta: One of A's three Islands is tapped at the start of the upkeep.
variants.expected: The first trigger resolves and is paid ({U}, 1 counter). The second trigger puts the 2nd counter, needs {1}{1} but only one Island is untapped, so A cannot pay and Illusionary Wall moves to A's graveyard (sacrificed).

variants.label: single_instance
variants.delta: Mana Chains is not on the battlefield, so Illusionary Wall has only its own instance.
variants.expected: Only one trigger: Illusionary Wall gets 1 age counter, A pays {U}, and Illusionary Wall stays on the battlefield with 1 age counter.

scenarios.forge_notes: Mana Chains grants 'Cumulative upkeep:1' as a second keyword instance; Forge should trigger it separately from the printed keyword.
